meta.name: apollo-multi-env-setup
meta.description:
Configure Apollo.io multi-environment setup.
Use when setting up development, staging, and production environments,
or managing multiple Apollo configurations.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo environments", "apollo staging",
"apollo dev prod", "apollo multi-tenant", "apollo env config".

copy.tagline: 为每个运行环境独立配置 Apollo.io
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Apollo.io 是你的日常工具,且需要管理多环境配置。
copy.tagline_en: Set up Apollo.io independently for each environment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Apollo.io is your daily tool and you need to manage env-specific configs.

howto.what: 配置Apollo.io多环境（开发、预发布、生产）。产出各环境配置文件、Kubernetes ConfigMap与Secret、环境感知客户端、功能开关、环境提升脚本。
howto.when: 当你说“apollo environments”、“apollo staging”等关键词，或要求配置开发、预发布、生产等多环境时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置Apollo的开发、暂存和生产环境
say.note: 会生成各环境配置和Kubernetes资源。

say.text: 为Apollo创建环境感知客户端
say.note: 客户端会自动识别当前环境加载配置。

say.text: 把Apollo配置从暂存环境提升到生产
say.note: 会运行环境提升脚本迁移配置。

howto.what_en: Configure Apollo.io for multiple environments (development, staging, production). Produces environment-specific configs, Kubernetes ConfigMaps/Secrets, an environment-aware client, per-environment feature flags, and promotion scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "apollo environments", "apollo staging", etc., or ask to set up development, staging, and production environments.

say_en.text: Configure my Apollo dev, staging, and production environments.
say_en.note: Generates environment configs and Kubernetes resources.

say_en.text: Create an environment-aware client for Apollo.
say_en.note: The client auto-loads the right config per environment.

say_en.text: Promote Apollo config from staging to production.
